verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs say you can 'instantly spin up as many virtual cards as you need' for any purpose, such as ad spend or contractors, and back this with card limits and spend controls. The Cards API can also issue virtual cards with spending limits programmatically. A five-year customer independently corroborates creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant/single-vendor locking, and detail on what 'spend controls' restrict beyond per-card limits (e.g., merchant category restrictions).
